question:
A diffraction-limited telescope has a circular objective of diameter $D=6.0\,\text{cm}$. It is used to observe two distant stars whose angular separation is $\Delta\theta=1.5\times10^{-5}\,\text{rad}$.

The observation is carried out with monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda=550\,\text{nm}$. Assume the image is limited only by diffraction at the circular aperture and use the Rayleigh criterion.

(i) Determine whether the two stars are resolved.

(ii) Find the minimum diameter $D_{\min}$ of the objective required to just resolve these two stars at the same wavelength.
